notes: Right hand in a worn tan leather glove with a snap wrist strap and a rolled khaki sleeve. The palm is pressed flat on a vertical stone face (palm toward -z, back of hand toward +z, thumb on -x), and the wrist is bent back so the forearm comes toward the viewer, dipping about 12 degrees as a compromise between the Front/Back drawings and the Right Side drawing. At the scale bar (10 cm = 87 px) the hand is about 21 cm long and the model is about 32 cm overall. The boxes use the pressed-hand drawings, the ones inside the stone outlines. The Left Side drawing is left out on purpose: it shows a relaxed hand in a different pose, with the sleeve on the opposite side to this model, so painting it would put the sleeve's colours on the hand.
